stages.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for a side-view 2D arcade fighting game, widescreen 16:9 composition, no UI and no fighters. A Brazilian public-school courtyard at spectacular golden-hour sunset, original scenery. Bold hand-inked classic late-1990s cel animation, richly painted backdrop with clear large shapes and saturated warm orange versus blue-violet lighting, high craft arcade environment. Brick school arcades across the BACK plane, broad trees on the far sides, outdoor stairs, distant hills of southern Brazil and radiant cumulus clouds, a few pennant strings high above the arena. The BOTTOM 40 percent is a broad EMPTY paved horizontal plaza for fighting, perspective paving lines, with the playable foot contact line at 86.8 percent of picture height. Keep all benches, plants, pillars, fences BEHIND that fighting plane, no foreground occlusion. Flat horizontal stage, camera straight-on, modest depth, no fish-eye. Render a single complete game background, not a screenshot, not a collage. No people, no readable text, no logos, no vignettes, no black bars, no characters, no interface. Strong atmospheric depth and graphic outlines matching hand-drawn martial arts characters.

Character faces RIGHT in a 3/4 fighting side view in all action poses; not facing the camera. impact.prompt: Production 2D fighting-game VFX sprite atlas on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. EXACT grid: FOUR columns by FIVE rows, TWENTY isolated separate fully contained drawings, equal square cells with generous empty margins, no bleed between cells, no text or grid lines. Hand-inked classic late-1990s arcade cel animation, crisp dark ink outline, white-hot contact core and colored tapered brush spikes, very energetic and graphic, no 3D, no circles with sun spokes, no soft particle cloud as the main shape. Row 1 four animation cels for LIGHT PUNCH CONTACT: tiny brilliant white cross flash, sharp irregular yellow/orange star burst, asymmetric long thin sparks, small fading sparks. Row 2 four animation cels for HEAVY KICK CONTACT: broad slashing white/cream contact flash with a sweeping orange/red crescent, explosive jagged brush star, longer angled tapered orange sparks and torn flame-like fragments, fading embers; noticeably bigger and more forceful than row 1. Row 3 four cels for a BLOCKED HIT: a narrow convex blue-white guarding crescent open to the RIGHT, increasingly fragmented cyan shards then dissipating ice-blue glints; no complete energy sphere or disk. Row 4 four cels for SUPER/POWER CONTACT: bold big white-core jagged impact, layered orange outer spikes and black ink accents, expanding torn lightning-like white shards, dissipating branching fragments. Row 5 four cels of the SAME tiny generic cute yellow cartoon bird in side-view FLYING TO THE RIGHT, black dot eye and small orange beak, orange feet tucked up, wings in four different flapping poses; fully drawn small bird, for dizzy-orbit animation over a fighter's head, no existing cartoon franchise character. No letters, no numbers, no faces, no other people or scenery. Clean actual transparency across all unused areas. Render all 20 complete finished cels in the exact 4x5 grid.
